name: ZX_FC_COUNTRY_DEFAULTS
description: This table stores tax defaults and controls for multiple countries. Each record contains tax defaults and controls for a specific country.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code

columns.name: TRANS_CATEG_CTRL_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Column for recording the maximum number of levels allowed for selection of transaction business category codes in the transactions for this country

columns.name: PRODUCT_CATEG_CTRL_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Column for recording the maximum number of levels allowed for selection of product category codes in the transactions for this country

columns.name: PRIMARY_INVENTORY_CATEGORY_SET

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: UNIQUENESS_VALIDATION_LEVEL
